reason: Electron desktop wrapper that bundles DeepSeek Harness and its web frontend, automatically starting the local server and displaying its interface in an installable desktop application.

summaries.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 服务器和网页前端封装为可安装的 Electron 桌面应用，并自动启动本地服务与打开界面。
summaries.en: An Electron desktop application that bundles DeepSeek Harness and its web frontend, starts the local server automatically, and displays the interface in an installable app.

capabilities: Starts a local DeepSeek Harness web server as a child process
Opens a local web interface in an Electron desktop window
Reads and writes local application data, logs, and server files
Can use configured local Node.js or DeepSeek Harness source paths
